description: Defines the InputBuffer class for managing media sample data, including audio/video info, DRM info, and buffer management, within the starboard::shared::starboard::player namespace.

classes.name: InputBuffer
classes.description: Encapsulates a media buffer with associated sample info, DRM info, and buffer management functions.

methods.name: InputBuffer
methods.description: Constructor template for initializing an InputBuffer with sample info, deallocation function, and context.

methods.name: ~InputBuffer
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up InputBuffer resources.

methods.name: sample_type
methods.description: Returns the media type (audio/video) of the sample.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the sample data buffer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns size of the sample data buffer.

methods.name: side_data
methods.description: Returns reference to side data associated with the sample.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the sample in microseconds.

methods.name: audio_sample_info
methods.description: Returns audio sample information; valid if sample type is audio.

methods.name: video_sample_info
methods.description: Returns video sample information; valid if sample type is video.

methods.name: audio_stream_info
methods.description: Returns audio stream info derived from audio sample info.

methods.name: video_stream_info
methods.description: Returns video stream info derived from video sample info.

methods.name: drm_info
methods.description: Returns DRM sample info if available.

methods.name: SetDecryptedContent
methods.description: Sets decrypted content data for the sample.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the InputBuffer.
